top_choice_rationale: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles rest on a clear structure-property rule (apparent pKa near-neutral in blood, cationic in the acidifying endosome, rapid-mixing assembly with a sheddable PEG-lipid) that made systemic siRNA and mRNA delivery possible, is validated at global scale, and changed what chemists and clinicians can do. A citation anchored on lipid design and assembly is complementary to the 2023 Medicine prize. The Cullis, MacLachlan, Anderson allocation is defensible though attribution should be checked against the expert report. P001 is a worthy, mature, cleanly attributed second choice, and an award is preferable to none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; B040 is topically close to my peptide, nanoparticle and biomaterials interests but there is no personal or institutional tie to the named candidates
